tests.name: native sessions keep real child state, ordered inputs and a separate owner reference
cases: a retried acceptance returns the same executionRef
changed creation parameters under one request identity are rejected as a conflict
input 1, 2, 2 observes 1, 3, 1 from the real child process
the same controlId returns its original observation without advancing twice
an out-of-order expectedSeq is refused before the process sees the input
stopRequested is true and a confirmed stop makes further inputs invalid
a second session starts from zero with a different execution reference
a normal product restart leaves the old session unable to advance

limitations: Windows only; Apple Silicon macOS not executed
OS-level file/network isolation not enforced or measured
no queue: the sample declares queuedSessions 0
no checkpoint or cross-owner takeover (deferred to #174)
